findings.text: the head fence-less probe is recorded as 5 passed in 3.05s while the log it cites ends at 5 passed in 3.14s, and the manifest artifacts line repeats 3.05, so a figure offered as the log's own summary line does not reconcile with the log on disk

the change is one kwarg and nothing in the repository fails if it regresses, because deleting no_fence_reason leaves all five cases green on any fence-capable host, and the only reproduction lives in logs/nsfshim.py under the run's log directory rather than in tests/

the header names revision, tree and command but no SLURM job id or partition, so the done_when clause requiring an all_debug job rests on the comment in gate-final.sbatch rather than on the log the manifest cites as its receipt
